parameters.query:
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, u.company_id,
       COALESCE(cp.setup_completed_at IS NOT NULL, false) AS setup_complete,
       COALESCE(cp.company_name, '') AS company_name
  FROM users u
  LEFT JOIN company_profile cp ON cp.id = u.company_id
 WHERE u.id = NULLIF(btrim($1::text), '')::uuid;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { token_ok: true, user: { id: $json.id, name: $json.name, email: $json.email, company_id: $json.company_id, company_name: $json.company_name, setup_complete: $json.setup_complete } } }}
